# Caffrey Recreation Area

> Family-run lakefront campground on the west shore of Lake Wallenpaupack, Lakeville, Pennsylvania (Poconos, Wayne County, off Route 590). RV/trailer and tent sites with boat launch, gas dock and camp store.

- Address: 431 Lakeshore Drive, Lakeville, PA 18438
- Phone: (570) 226-4608 · Email: Reservations@caffreyrecreation.com
- RV/Trailer: $52 regular, $58 weekend, $65 holiday per night
- Tent (2 tents/site): $40 regular, $46 weekend, $48 holiday per night
- Rates include 4 guests; extra guests $10/night (max 8); kids under 5 free
- Every site: 30 amp electric, water, picnic table, fire ring; dump station access
- Boat storage + launch: $10 per stay. On-site gas dock. Slips.
- Camp store: camping and fishing supplies, firewood, ice cream. Coin-operated showers and laundry.
- Check-in 1 PM, check-out 12 PM. Quiet hours 10 PM to 7 AM.
- No swimming, no alcohol, no smoking or vaping, no outside firewood.
- No pets.
- Hours: Thu & Sun 9–5, Fri & Sat 9–6, closed Mon–Wed
- Neighbor: Capri Marine (Chaparral boat dealer)
